dishes.name: Basler Läckerli
dishes.desc: Chewy spiced honey biscuit with candied peel, almonds and hazelnuts, glazed white on top. Basel's signature sweet, sold in tins at the city's old confectioners.

dishes.name: Basler Mehlsuppe
dishes.desc: Soup of deeply browned flour and onions in beef stock, finished with grated cheese. Tied to Fasnacht, but served in traditional Basel restaurants through the colder months.

dishes.name: Basler Zwiebelwähe
dishes.desc: Savoury onion tart with egg and cream on a thin pastry base. Eaten in Basel at Fasnacht and in bakeries and cafés through the year.

dishes.name: Basler Brunsli
dishes.desc: Small chocolate and almond biscuits with cinnamon, baked at Christmas time in Basel bakeries and confectioners. They are soft inside and slightly crisp outside.

dishes.name: Suure Mocke
dishes.desc: Beef marinated in vinegar and spices, then braised into a rich sour stew. A traditional Basel-area Sunday dish, found in old-style restaurants.
